comments: Input facts: intersection-cross-traffic; both partners are cars; ego is the initiator and agent1 the responder; both planned intersection paths cross. Chosen assumptions: four-way junction, lateral approaches, 12-24 m initial approach clearance, nonzero initial speeds equal to trajectory target speeds (m/s), and ego reaching the crossing 0.1-0.45 s before agent1 under constant-speed estimates. The crossing opportunity is intentional; no collision is required. Ego turns left across the straight path of agent1 approaching from the left. Agent1 brakes in response to ego entering the junction and later completes its straight crossing. Braking is triggered only after ego enters its connecting lane and the partners are within 14-17 m; brake control 0.65-0.85 is held until ego leaves that lane and separation reaches 12 m.
